Imagine being a young boy, suddenly forced to leave everything familiar behind—your home, your family, your sense of security. That’s the journey we’re about to take together, as we step into the world of In the Sea There are Crocodiles, a powerful story crafted by Fabio Geda from the real-life experiences of Enaiatollah Akbari.
Through Enaiatollah’s eyes, we’ll travel across borders and cultures, feeling the uncertainty, the hope, and the raw determination it takes to survive when the world you knew slips away. His journey isn’t just about escaping danger in Afghanistan—it’s a search for belonging, where trust is fragile and every day is a test of courage and adaptability.
As we walk beside Enaiatollah, we’ll witness the very real struggles that so many refugees face: losing their homes, relying on the kindness of strangers, and finding light in the darkest moments. We’ll meet smugglers, border guards, and fellow travelers, all of whom shape the path ahead. Each encounter reveals not just the risks and fears, but also those unexpected sparks of compassion and strength that push him forward.
So, as we begin this journey together, let’s open our hearts and minds. We’re about to explore what it really means to find home—and how hope can endure, even when the odds seem impossible.
